result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a text rendering/overlap problem in the restaurant info line of the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: Under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar listing, the delivery time and delivery fee text are overlapping. The line reads '25-3€0 delivery • Ramen', where the '0' from '25-30 min' and the '€0 delivery' label are merging into unreadable text, suggesting a z-index or absolute-positioning collision between two text elements.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery time and delivery fee are rendered in separate, properly laid-out containers (e.g., flexbox row with correct spacing) so they do not overlap. Review the CSS/layout logic that positions these two text nodes relative to each other.
